fileStructure:
DECISIONS.md: the decision record. Find the tracked path with `git ls-files | grep -i 'DECISIONS.md$'`; the kinds come from templates/DECISIONS-header.md. Records filename ownership winning and body ownership rejected.
tests/test-scripts.sh: three new red-first cases. Each creates a sentinel with the real writer (scripts/ops-task.sh) and checks two readers against it: the gate (scripts/ops-stop-hook.sh) and the bar (scripts/statusline.sh).
tests/floors.env: FLOOR_SHELL goes up by 3, in the same commit as the cases.
.claude-plugin/plugin.json: version set to 0.13.0.
CHANGELOG.md: new top heading `## [0.13.0]` describing the decision and the cases.
Read, not edited: scripts/lib/partition.sh (sentinel_owner_of_name, scan_pending), scripts/ops-task.sh, scripts/ops-adopt.sh, scripts/ops-verdict.sh, scripts/ops-sessionstart-hook.sh, scripts/validate_plugin.py.

tasks.title: Record in DECISIONS.md that ownership stays in the filename, and why body ownership was rejected
files: DECISIONS.md (tracked path found with `git ls-files | grep -i 'DECISIONS.md$'`; append only)
templates/DECISIONS-header.md (read only, for the kind enum)
tasks.testCycle: `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py; echo rc=$?` prints rc=0 (check_decisions_schema accepts the new entry). `grep -c 'owner=<sid>' <DECISIONS.md path>` prints at least 1, and `grep -c 'fail CLOSED\|fails CLOSED' <DECISIONS.md path>` prints at least 1.
tasks.specExcerpt:
1. Decide filename-vs-body ownership. The decision must weigh: the six hand-copied readers, the builtin-only constraint, the O_EXCL open in ops-task.sh, the legacy migration in ops-sessionstart-hook.sh, and that an unowned sentinel must keep failing CLOSED. Record the decision and the rejected option in DECISIONS.md.
2. If body ownership wins: change ops-task.sh, ops-adopt.sh and ops-verdict.sh to write the field, and the three readers' sentinel_owner_of_name() to read it, keeping the bounded read and the `-L` before `-f` type test.

NORTH STAR: Sentinel ownership lives where six readers and three writers agree on it, and the Stop gate still blocks on mine + unowned. Missed if: any reader and writer disagree on an owner, or an unowned sentinel stops blocking.

DECISION (made by this plan, so requirement 2 does not apply): FILENAME ownership stays.
steps: Branch from main: `git fetch origin && git checkout -b feat/sentinel-owner-decision origin/main`. Record the baseline: `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py; echo rc=$?` and `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | tail -3`. Run the shell suite on its own, never alongside another run. Write both results down.

Read `templates/DECISIONS-header.md`. Pick the RECORD kind (not a gated kind) that fits a design decision, and note the exact column format. Check the pick against `DECISIONS_RECORD_KINDS` in `scripts/validate_plugin.py`: `grep -n 'DECISIONS_RECORD_KINDS\|DECISIONS_GATED_KINDS' scripts/validate_plugin.py`. Do not use the HANDOFF-MARK kind.

Confirm the facts the entry will cite, and cite each by symbol, not by line number: `grep -n 'sentinel_owner_of_name' scripts/lib/partition.sh scripts/*.sh`, `grep -n 'O_EXCL\|set -C\|noclobber' scripts/ops-task.sh`, `grep -n 'mv \|rename' scripts/ops-adopt.sh scripts/ops-verdict.sh`, and `grep -n 'legacy\|migrat' scripts/ops-sessionstart-hook.sh`. If anything argued below is not in the code, fix that argument before writing the entry.

Append one row in the header's format. Decision: ownership stays in the filename (`pending/<sid>__<task>`), and `pending/<task>` stays unowned and fails CLOSED. Rejected: a body field `owner=<sid>`. The reasons, one clause each: (a) moving an owner is one atomic rename in ops-adopt.sh and ops-verdict.sh, while a body field needs write-temp-then-rename and gives readers a torn-read window; (b) the builtin-only readers (ops-stop-hook.sh and statusline.sh through lib/partition.sh) classify from the name without opening the file, while body ownership would add a bounded read, a NUL probe and an untrusted-body parse to every reader, including the statusline's ~300ms render budget; (c) a stale `.operator/bin/` next to a newer plugin hook (#34/#82) would have writers and readers using different schemes during the upgrade window, which is exactly the North Star miss; (d) the sessionstart legacy migration would need a second, filename→body migration with its own reject set, making a seventh copy; (e) O_EXCL in ops-task.sh gives no reason to switch, because it guards creation, not ownership; (f) unowned fails CLOSED under both schemes, so this is not a deciding factor. Cost accepted: six hand-copied parsers, kept in step by check_guard_parity.

Run `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py; echo rc=$?` and expect rc=0. Then run the grep checks from testCycle. Commit with `git add <DECISIONS.md path> && git commit -m 'decide: sentinel ownership stays in the filename; body owner= rejected'`.

tasks.title: Three red-first shell cases (owned, unowned, foreign), each checking the writer against both readers, plus FLOOR_SHELL +3
files: tests/test-scripts.sh (add three new Case blocks next to the existing "sentinel ownership" block)
produces: Case: ownership agreement — owned sentinel blocks its owner and the bar agrees
Case: ownership agreement — unowned sentinel blocks every session
Case: ownership agreement — foreign sentinel is reported, never blocks
tasks.testCycle: `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | tail -3`, run alone, shows passed = baseline passed + 3, failed = baseline failed with the same failing names, and skipped unchanged. Mutation proof: in a scratch worktree, each of the three mutations turns exactly its own case red. `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py; echo rc=$?` gives rc=0, and `shellcheck tests/test-scripts.sh` is clean.
tasks.specExcerpt:
3. Add red-first cases to tests/test-scripts.sh for: owned, unowned (blocks), foreign (reports).
5. Raise FLOOR_SHELL in tests/floors.env by the number of cases added.

NORTH STAR: ... the Stop gate still blocks on mine + unowned. Missed if: any reader and writer disagree on an owner, or an unowned sentinel stops blocking.

CLAUDE.md: floors are FLOORS (>=) over passed+skipped, raised in the SAME commit as the cases. ops-stop-hook.sh blocks on mine + unowned and only reports foreign. A statusline that describes a different gate from the one that runs is worse than no statusline. An 'X was not written' assertion uses unchanged_lines/unchanged_bytes/delta_is/both_present, never a bare `=`.
steps: Read the existing fixtures first: `grep -n '^echo "-- Case' tests/test-scripts.sh | grep -i 'ownership\|statusline segment'`. Then read the "sentinel ownership" and "statusline segment reports the gate" blocks in full. Copy their project-fixture setup, the Stop-hook stdin JSON shape (session_id, stop_hook_active) and the statusline invocation exactly. Do not write new harness code. If an existing case already asserts one of the three behaviours below, keep the new case: it differs because the sentinel comes from the real writer CLI and both readers are checked against it.

Write the three cases, each opened with its own `echo "-- Case ..."` header using the exact titles in produces. In every case, create the sentinel with the writer, not by hand. (1) OWNED: `bash scripts/ops-task.sh t1 --owner S1` in the fixture. Check that the file `pending/S1__t1` exists. Check that the Stop hook with session_id S1 exits 2. Check that the statusline for S1 counts the task as blocking. (2) UNOWNED: `bash scripts/ops-task.sh t2` with no --owner. If the CLI refuses that, create the pre-0.4 shape with `: > .operator/pending/t2` and say so in a comment. Check that the Stop hook exits 2 for session S1 AND for a different session S2, and that the statusline shows it as blocking. (3) FOREIGN: `bash scripts/ops-task.sh t3 --owner S2`. Check that the Stop hook for S1 exits 0 and that its output names the foreign task. Check that the statusline for S1 shows it as foreign and not blocking.
Raise FLOOR_SHELL in tests/floors.env by exactly 3: `grep -n FLOOR_SHELL tests/floors.env`, then change N to N+3.

Prove each case goes red, in an isolated tree only: `git worktree add /tmp/own-mut HEAD && cp tests/test-scripts.sh tests/floors.env /tmp/own-mut/tests/`. In /tmp/own-mut/scripts/lib/partition.sh, change sentinel_owner_of_name one mutation at a time and restore it with `git -C /tmp/own-mut checkout -- scripts/lib/partition.sh` between runs. M1: return the owner as the task half (split on the LAST `__`), so OWNED goes red. M2: classify an empty owner as foreign, so UNOWNED goes red. M3: return an empty owner for every name, so FOREIGN goes red because it now blocks. For each mutation, run `bash /tmp/own-mut/tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | grep -A2 'ownership agreement'` and record which case failed. If a mutation leaves its case green, the case is vacuous: fix the case, not the mutation. Finally `git worktree remove /tmp/own-mut`.

In the real tree, run the testCycle commands: the suite alone, the validator, and shellcheck. Report the delta against the baseline from owner-decision. Commit with `git add tests/test-scripts.sh tests/floors.env && git commit -m 'tests: owned/unowned/foreign ownership agreement cases, writer vs gate vs bar; FLOOR_SHELL +3'`.

tasks.specExcerpt:
4. Bump plugin.json to 0.13.0 and add the matching CHANGELOG heading.

CLAUDE.md: `plugin.json` `version` → add the matching `## [x.y.z]` as the newest heading in `CHANGELOG.md`, same commit (the release gate fails otherwise).
steps: Negative control: set .claude-plugin/plugin.json "version" to "0.13.0" first, with no CHANGELOG change. Run the release gate and expect it to fail on the version/heading mismatch. If it passes, stop and report that the release gate did not catch the mismatch.

Add `## [0.13.0]` above the current newest heading in CHANGELOG.md, following the existing entries' date and style (`sed -n '1,30p' CHANGELOG.md`). Content: sentinel ownership stays in the filename, with body `owner=` rejected (pointing to the DECISIONS.md entry), and the three ownership-agreement cases with FLOOR_SHELL +3. No runtime behaviour changed.

Run the testCycle commands, plus `shellcheck scripts/*.sh scripts/lib/*.sh` because CI runs it first. Commit with `git add .claude-plugin/plugin.json CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m 'v0.13.0: sentinel ownership decision recorded; ownership-agreement cases'`. Push only with `git push -u origin feat/sentinel-owner-decision`.
